responsibility: Applies inlining decisions to the callgraph and function bodies. It clones or reuses callee nodes for inline edges, updates counts, manages clone trees and saved source bodies, materializes needed called clones with parameter adjustments, redirects call statements, removes obsolete references, and invokes optimize_inline_calls plus CFG/SSA fixups. This is the transformation/execution half of inlining, separate from the heuristic choice logic in ipa-inline.cc and cost estimation in ipa-inline-analysis.cc.
